title: distribution.paid
description: Emitted by treasury's distribution handler after post_journal_entry books a dividend/interest payment to a holder. Visibility-plane announcement, downstream of the durable ledger write — carries entry_id so the payout is self-verifying against journal_entry.posted in the public archive.

schema_version.description: Bumped on breaking shape change. Consumers branch on it.

openly_operated.description: Set at emit time from local SSM tenant metadata. The publication rule's filter — true means the payout surfaces on the public stream.

customer_id.description: Tenant identifier. Redundant with envelope account-id but saves consumers a join.

instrument_id.description: The instrument that paid — the rules-params row / offer id keyed to the holder.

holder.description: The holder's contact_id. An opaque reference, not PII.

rule.description: The distribution rule that fired, e.g. net_income_percent_dividend / net_income_percent_perpetuity / interest_perpetuity. A free string, not an enum — the rule families grow, and a stale enum would reject new instruments.

amount.description: Amount paid this cycle (the positive delta posted to DIVIDENDS_PAYABLE). Always > 0 — a zero-delta cycle emits nothing.

period_end.description: ISO-8601 period close that fired this distribution (matches accounting's periodEnd). Idempotency fold-point: one distribution per (instrument, period_end).

cumulative_paid.description: Total paid to this instrument through this cycle, inclusive. Folds over the ledger; drives cap fulfillment.

cap_remaining.description: Optional. Present only for capped instruments — cap minus cumulative_paid after this payment. Absent on perpetuities (no cap). Reaching 0 stamps the instrument's end_time.

entry_id.description: The journal_entry.posted entry_id this payout booked. The verification join: read distribution.paid off the public stream, check it against the ledger entry.
